agent_added_needs.title: Written termination notice and the official form served with it
agent_added_needs.legal_basis: Art. 266l OR requires a landlord's termination of residential premises to be made on an approved form.
agent_added_needs.reason: No termination notice is included; this is a specific essential item for the proposed termination challenge procedure.

agent_added_needs.title: Proof of receipt and date of service of the termination notice
agent_added_needs.legal_basis: Art. 273(1) OR; the challenge period is 30 days from receipt of the termination.
agent_added_needs.reason: The exact date of receipt is not established in the message, but controls the challenge deadline.

agent_steps: Establish whether a formal termination was served and protect the challenge deadline
product_extra.answer: A formal termination cannot yet be assessed: the tenant is still awaiting the letter. Request the notice, official form, and proof/date of receipt when received. agent_questions: An welchem Kalenderdatum sprach der Hauswart die Erhöhung an, und ist seither ein amtliches Formular oder eine andere schriftliche Mitteilung der Vermieterin eingegangen?

agent_steps: Erstreckungsbegehren innert Frist bei der Schlichtungsbehörde einreichen

agent_added_needs.legal_basis: Art. 269a lit. b OR; Art. 14 VMWG
